---
title: "NYC Restaurant Inspections Dashboard"
output:
  flexdashboard::flex_dashboard:
    orientation: rows
    vertical_layout: fill
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)
library(p8105.datasets)

knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = FALSE,
  message = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE
)

data(rest_inspec)
```
Row
-------------------------------------

### Restaurant Grades

```{r grade_bar}
grade_data =
  rest_inspec |>
  filter(grade %in% c("A", "B", "C")) |>
  count(grade)

plot_ly(
  grade_data,
  x = ~grade,
  y = ~n,
  type = "bar",
  color = ~grade,
  colors = c("#6F8FAF", "#B58DB6", "#D9897E")
) |>
  layout(
    xaxis = list(title = "Grade"),
    yaxis = list(title = "Number of Records"),
    showlegend = FALSE
  )
```
### Inspection Scores

```{r score_boxplot}
score_data =
  rest_inspec |>
  filter(
    grade %in% c("A", "B", "C"),
    !is.na(score)
  )

plot_ly(
  score_data,
  x = ~grade,
  y = ~score,
  type = "box",
  color = ~grade,
  colors = c("#6F8FAF", "#B58DB6", "#D9897E")
) |>
  layout(
    xaxis = list(title = "Grade"),
    yaxis = list(title = "Inspection Score"),
    showlegend = FALSE
  )
```

Row
-------------------------------------

### Inspections by Borough

```{r borough_scatter}
borough_time =
  rest_inspec |>
  filter(
    !is.na(score),
    !is.na(boro),
    boro != "0",
    !is.na(inspection_date)
  ) |>
  mutate(
    inspection_date = as.Date(inspection_date),
    year = lubridate::floor_date(inspection_date, "year")
  ) |>
  group_by(year, boro) |>
  summarize(
    average_score = mean(score, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

plot_ly(
  borough_time,
  x = ~year,
  y = ~average_score,
  color = ~boro,
  colors = c(
    "#8B6F9E",
    "#6F8FAF",
    "#5F9E91",
    "#9CAF88",
    "#D6A85F"
  ),
  type = "scatter",
  mode = "lines+markers",
  hoverinfo = "text",
  text = ~paste(
    boro,
    "<br>Year:", format(year, "%Y"),
    "<br>Average score:", round(average_score, 1)
  )
) |>
  layout(
    xaxis = list(title = "Inspection Date"),
    yaxis = list(title = "Average Inspection Score"),
    legend = list(title = list(text = "Borough"))
  )
```
